title: Enable domain experts without pretending all builders are engineers
text: The video-derived note distinguishes reusable skills and subject-matter intent from engineering responsibility, and calls for a governed development lifecycle for non-technical builders. This supports a division between contributing business knowledge, experimenting safely and accepting responsibility for a production service.
qualification: Source-note synthesis; it does not specify a complete production standard. The practical promotion gates in this knowledge base are proposed applications.
